description: A braid of fine copper that soaks up melted solder, for cleaning pads and removing small joints.
how_to_use: Lay the braid on the joint, press the hot iron on top of it — the solder melts and runs into the braid. Lift both together, then cut off the used silver end.

plain.what: A copper braid that soaks up melted solder, to clean a joint.
plain.how: Lay it on the solder, press the hot iron on top, and the solder soaks into the braid.
